- **GEAR:
	- Gear undergoes regular wear and tear, much more if you fight on the frontlines, EXTREME damage can be done if you suffer a critical hit or go down.

| Gear            | Degradation Effects                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Armor           | Armor undergoes gradual losses to its AC value -1 up to -5                                                                                                                                                             |
| Weapons         | Weapons lose quality, slowly losing to hit bonus and damage bonus, from -1 up to -5                                                                                                                                    |
| Other Equipment | Other equipment suffers degradation, like spellcasting foci, staves can slowly deteriorate, especially if  lots of high leveled spells are cast in a short period of time (- values). Other things must be improvised. |
